meta_description: Keen Towing & Recovery serving Lenoir - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in Lenoir.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
explore_h2: If it will not move, we will move it
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Lenoir and the towns around it.
area_h2: Where we take on towing work near Lenoir
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Rotator truck lit up with blue LED lighting at night
services.evidence: Crane truck at a recovery site lifting a large white trailer among crushed guardrails

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: White rotator crane truck parked with a billboard visible in the background
services.evidence: White heavy-duty rotator tow truck parked, side view

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.alt: Patriotic flag-livery heavy rotator crane truck parked with its boom extended
services.evidence: White flatbed truck parked on gravel near a brick building

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.
services.evidence: Rotator truck lit up with blue LED lighting at night

reviews.author: Melanie Ruiz
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of using Keen Towing, and I can confidently say it was one of the best experiences I've ever had with a towing service. From the moment I called, their customer service was outstanding. The staff was professional, friendly, and attentive to my needs, shout out to Andy!

reviews.author: Sherry Nc
reviews.text: This has got to be BEST towing company around WNC! and Kenneth knows what he is doing for sure! We had an awful situation on a personal bridge with a truck full of gravel. Kenneth saved the day! and Andy was just as nice when explaining what happened and our needs. They were fast, fair and excellent at getting the job done!

reviews.author: Mark Stitt
reviews.text: Andy from Keen's Towing consistently provides exceptional service, demonstrating a strong commitment to client satisfaction. We have engaged Andy's company on numerous occasions, and their performance has consistently met our expectations. We extend our prayers for the continued success of their organization and its employees.

reviews.author: Liliana Zapata
reviews.text: This was my first time calling in for Keen Towing service and I can share it was greatly appreciated. Kenny was helpful with getting my car at the mechanic and making sure everything went well. Will definitely recommend.

reviews.author: mike woolard
reviews.text: I have been dealing with Keen Towing for many years back when Keith owned it. Then new owner Andy is taking it to new heights and doing a great job. Highly recommend Keen Towing

reviews.author: Chase Allen
reviews.text: Incredible service, fast response, very professional, and clearly knew what they were doing. Super friendly too. Couldn’t ask for a better towing experience.

reviews.author: Brian Auten
reviews.text: Best services in the region. They can, will, and have recovered about anything ya could think of. I’ve used them tons of times, from towing a multitude of vehicles, to assisting with heavy-lifts. Don’t listen to the petty false reviews and petulant females with a thirst for attention. These guys are as legit as they come.

reviews.author: dante Kimbrough
reviews.text: I literally do not know where to began about this towing company. From the very pleasant and sweet lady that assisted me on the phone, to the towing service provided, all were beyond exceptional. Andy is top of the line when it comes to customer service, lightening fast response, and professionally knowledgeable on all aspects of towing. I have never in my life seen a towing company arrive so fast, especially given the fact that he stays busy. I would 1000% recommend KEEN to handle all your towing needs. Andy towed me from Boone/Lenoir to Blacksburg SC, it was a super pleasant experience. He is a safe and courteous gentleman, and you are guaranteed to have a great intellectual conversation on the way to your destination. Words cant express how pleased I was with KEEN towing. Andy you truly are appreciated, stay safe. I thank you brother.

reviews.author: Cameron Rozzelle
reviews.text: Andy has always taken care of us and our business with any towing needs. He is always kind, courteous and prompt with his service. His staff is always kind to us and professional. Thank you Andy and Carlos for all you do in taking great care and going great lengths to make sure we’re always taken care of. And another thing I always notice is, his equipment is always clean and nice inside and out.

reviews.author: bill
reviews.text: Andy is working his tail off decking trailers for me. Couldn't ask for a better person. Much appreciated for keen helping

reviews.author: Retzit Adams
reviews.text: These guys are the greatest!!! They came all the way to Mountain City, TN to help us. When a wrecker couldn't be used for our situation, Scott Kilpatrick got my number. He said he would text me the next morning with a number for someone that could help fix the axle. I really doubted that I would hear back from him because people just forget. He didn't forget, he texted at 8am the very next morning and had me to send him pics of my axle. He sent them to someone else and then got me the help I needed. Who does this in this day and time???? Not many people!! Thank you so very very much, you all are the best!!!! God bless you Scott, you're the best!!!!

reviews.author: Tammy Duckworth
reviews.text: I pray that I dont need Andy but when I do he is just a call or text away. Great family yo deal with.

reviews.author: Chrystal Pate
reviews.text: Kenny showed up at a decent timeframe, and was able to load my vehicle safely even in a difficult driveway. They even communicated when it was delivered to the shop I sent it to, including a photo evidence.

reviews.author: Patrick Barbee
reviews.text: Kenny was quick and courteous he loaded me and my truck up and got us home safely! Thanks again Kenny!
